title: Choose a local or remote actor
subtitle: Both deployments use the same authenticated actor-learner protocol and durability guarantees.

nodes.label: One Windows host
nodes.detail: Launcher starts separate actor and learner processes using spawn.

nodes.label: Local gRPC
nodes.detail: The actor connects over loopback. Rollouts still pass authentication.

nodes.label: Separate game host
nodes.detail: The remote actor drives Trackmania and retains a durable rollout spool.

nodes.label: SSH or VPN tunnel
nodes.detail: Authenticated encryption forwards the learner loopback endpoint.

nodes.label: Shared learner runtime
nodes.detail: Authenticate identity → commit WAL → apply replay → update learner → publish policy / checkpoint

notes.text:
IDENTITY
Both sides must agree on the run fingerprint, map and contracts. The bearer token authorizes requests.

ENCRYPTION
The bearer token does not encrypt traffic. Keep learner gRPC on loopback and tunnel remote access.
